messages:
Alex P.: Hey team — got a quick Q: my partner transferred legal custody of their 7yo to me last week. Can I add them to medical/dental midyear as a QLE? What docs and deadlines do you need?
People Ops: Congrats — yes this qualifies as a Qualified Life Event (custody change). We can add the dependent midyear if we get the required documentation within 30 days of the custody change date. Quick checklist below.
People Ops: ```Required docs (upload to Benefits Hub or email benefits@redwood.com):
- Court order or signed custody/guardianship document (PDF)
- Proof of child identity (birth certificate or passport)
- Proof of your relationship/residency (school record, official mail) dated within last 60 days
- SSN or ITIN for the dependent (if pending, see note)
```
Alex P.: thanks — custody order is final and dated 2026-02-14. I can get a scanned copy today. SSN is pending — we applied but not issued yet.
People Ops: SSN pending is okay to start enrollment. Please upload a screenshot of the SSN application/receipt and put "SSN pending" in the SSN field. Coverage can be set to the custody order date once we have the court order and the SSN is provided within 60 days. If SSN never arrives, we may need to remove the dependent and refund/prorate per payroll rules.
Jamal S.: Quick Q — does dental and vision come along automatically or do I have to opt them in separately?
People Ops: You need to select the specific plans during the QLE enrollment flow. Medical and dental are separate elections. If you don't pick dental/vision during the QLE window we'll enroll only the plans you selected.
Alex P.: And payroll proration — will the premium start from Feb 14 or from when benefits team processes it?
People Ops: We set the benefit effective date to the custody order date (Feb 14) if docs are received within 30 days. Payroll will retro-prorate premiums on the next run and you may see an adjustment over 1-2 pay cycles. If docs are submitted after 30 days, effective date = date of submission.
Emily HR: Alex, please DM me the child's name and DOB (PII) and I'll kick off the Workday change request so we can speed processing.
People Ops: Also note for dependents with foreign documents: include translations and apostilles where applicable. If anything is unclear ping us here or DM. :thumbsup:
Benefits Bot: Reminder — Benefits Hub QLE form link: https://benefits.redwood.com/qle (upload only PDFs)
Alex P.: Uploaded court order + school enrollment PDF to the Hub. Marking this resolved unless you need anything else. Thanks!
People Ops: Got it — we'll process within 3 business days and confirm once the dependent is added. If we need additional items we'll tag you.
